Apa dampak pengakuan wawasan nusantara hasil Deklarasi Djuanda dalam hukum laut internasional?
options: Laut di antara pulau-pulau diakui sebagai wilayah perairan pedalaman Indonesia
Wilayah daratan Indonesia terbelah menjadi banyak bagian terpisah
Kapal asing bebas mengambil sumber daya ikan di seluruh perairan
Luas kedaulatan laut Republik Indonesia berkurang drastis

quiz.q: Perilaku apakah yang menunjukkan tindakan bela negara yang dapat dilakukan oleh siswa di lingkungan sekolah?
options: Mengunggah berita bohong yang memicu pertengkaran di media sosial
Belajar giat serta menjaga kerukunan dan persatuan antarteman
Menolak berteman dengan siswa yang berasal dari pulau lain

quiz.q: Mengapa kawasan perbatasan dan pulau-pulau terluar perlu dijaga keamanannya dengan ketat?
options: Agar tidak dikunjungi oleh para wisatawan domestik
Untuk mencegah pencurian sumber daya alam dan klaim wilayah oleh pihak asing
Supaya penduduk setempat tidak dapat berpindah ke kota besar
Untuk mengurangi biaya pembangunan sarana pendidikan di pedalaman

chapters.title: Semangat Gotong Royong dalam Kehidupan Berbangsa
paragraphs: Gotong royong adalah kegiatan kerja bersama-sama yang dilakukan oleh sekelompok warga tanpa pamrih demi kepentingan umum. Gotong royong berakar dari nilai luhur bangsa Indonesia yang memandang manusia tidak bisa hidup sendiri tanpa bantuan orang lain. Kebiasaan ini menciptakan kerukunan dan ikatan kekeluargaan yang erat di tengah-tengah pergaulan masyarakat.

Berbagai daerah di Indonesia memiliki istilah adat khas untuk menyebut kegiatan tolong-menolong atau gotong royong ini. Di masyarakat Jawa terdapat tradisi Sambatan untuk mendirikan rumah warga dan masyarakat Sunda menyebutnya Rereongan. Masyarakat Minahasa di Sulawesi Utara memiliki tradisi Mapalus, sedangkan petani di Bali memiliki kelompok Subak untuk mengatur irigasi persawahan.

Kegiatan gotong royong mendatangkan banyak manfaat nyata bagi kehidupan bermasyarakat di desa maupun di perkotaan. Beban pekerjaan yang berat dan memakan waktu lama dapat diselesaikan dengan lebih ringan serta lebih cepat secara bersama-sama. Gotong royong membersihkan selokan kampung dan pos ronda malam menciptakan lingkungan hidup yang aman dan sehat.

Di lingkungan sekolah dasar, gotong royong tampak saat siswa bersama-sama membersihkan ruang kelas sesuai pembagian jadwal piket. Siswa bekerja sama menata buku di perpustakaan sekolah dan menghias dinding kelas untuk menyambut perayaan hari kemerdekaan. Solidaritas sosial juga dipraktikkan dengan mengumpulkan sumbangan sukarela bagi teman yang sedang tertimpa musibah sakit.

Semangat gotong royong harus tetap dipertahankan di tengah perkembangan zaman agar masyarakat tidak berubah menjadi sosok individualis. Sikap individualisme yang hanya mementingkan diri sendiri dan mengabaikan kesulitan tetangga bertentangan dengan jati diri bangsa Indonesia. Gotong royong menjadi kekuatan utama bangsa Indonesia dalam menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan berbangsa.

quiz.q: Apa ciri pokok dari kegiatan gotong royong yang dilakukan oleh masyarakat Indonesia?
options: Dilakukan dengan mengharapkan upah harian yang besar
Dilakukan secara sukarela dan bersama-sama untuk kepentingan bersama
Dikerjakan secara terpaksa karena adanya ancaman sanksi hukum
Hanya dilakukan oleh warga yang memiliki rumah di pedesaan

quiz.q: Apa sebutan tradisi gotong royong dalam mendirikan rumah bersama yang dikenal pada masyarakat di Jawa?
Sistem gotong royong pembagian air irigasi persawahan secara adil yang ada di Pulau Bali disebut...
Apa manfaat praktis yang dirasakan warga saat melakukan gotong royong membersihkan selokan lingkungan?
options: Pekerjaan terasa lebih berat dan melelahkan
Pekerjaan menjadi lebih cepat selesai dan lingkungan terhindar dari banjir
Biaya pembayaran pajak kebersihan menjadi bertambah mahal
Warga tidak perlu lagi saling mengenal nama tetangganya

quiz.q: Contoh kegiatan gotong royong yang dapat dipraktikkan oleh siswa di lingkungan sekolah adalah...
options: Mengerjakan lembar soal ulangan harian secara bersama-sama
Melaksanakan tugas piket kebersihan kelas bersama teman regu
Menyembunyikan buku pelajaran milik teman sebangku
Bermain bola di dalam ruang kelas saat pelajaran kosong

quiz.q: Sikap apakah yang bertentangan dengan nilai gotong royong karena hanya mementingkan diri sendiri?

chapters.title: Introducing Yourself and Others Professionally
paragraphs: Introducing yourself in a professional setting requires stating your name, your current role, and your educational background. Use phrases like My name is, I am a student at, or I am currently studying to provide clear information to your interlocutor. Always maintain eye contact and offer a firm handshake to establish a positive first impression.

When introducing someone else, use the phrase I would like to introduce you to or This is followed by their name and professional designation. This structure ensures that both parties understand their relationship to one another and the context of the meeting. Proper introductions facilitate smoother networking and workplace communication.

Personal pronouns and possessive adjectives are essential components for self-introduction and identifying others. Use I, my, or mine when speaking about yourself, and he, she, his, or hers when introducing your peers. Consistent usage of these pronouns prevents confusion during formal interactions.

The verb to be, such as am, is, and are, serves as the primary connector in introductory sentences. Use am for the first person singular, is for the third person singular, and are for plural subjects or the second person. These verbs define the state of being or identity of the person being introduced.

Consider this example of a professional introduction in an office setting. Hello, my name is Andi, and I am an intern here at the IT department. It is a pleasure to meet you, and I look forward to working with your team on this project.

quiz.q: Which phrase is most appropriate for introducing a colleague to a client?
options: I want you to know him
He is a guy I know

quiz.q: What is the correct use of the verb to be for a singular third person?
When introducing yourself, which information is most relevant for a vocational student?
options: Your name and area of study

quiz.q: Which possessive adjective is used when referring to a female peer?
What is the function of the verb to be in an introduction?
options: To link the subject to their identity

quiz.q: Which sentence follows correct grammar for self-introduction?

chapters.title: Describing People and Their Characteristics
paragraphs: Describing people involves identifying physical appearance and personality traits using specific adjectives. Use height, build, and hair color to describe physical features, such as tall, athletic, or wavy hair. Personality adjectives include diligent, creative, or patient to convey character.

Comparative adjectives allow you to contrast two people or objects by adding -er or using more before the word. For example, use taller than or more hardworking than to show a clear difference in a specific attribute. This structure is vital for performance reviews or team evaluations.

Use the verb have or has to describe physical attributes like eyes, hair, or facial features. I have brown eyes and she has a round face are standard structures in descriptive English. Ensure subject-verb agreement by using has for singular subjects and have for plural subjects.

Adverbs of degree such as very, quite, or extremely modify adjectives to indicate the intensity of a trait. Saying someone is very punctual emphasizes their reliability more than simply saying they are punctual. These modifiers add nuance and precision to your descriptions.

Observe the following description of a technician. Mr. John is a very skilled mechanic who has short black hair and a muscular build. He is more experienced than the other staff members and always works with great precision.

quiz.q: Which word is an example of a personality trait?
What is the correct comparative form of the adjective smart?
Which verb is correct for describing physical features of a singular person?
What do adverbs of degree like very do to an adjective?
Which sentence correctly uses a comparative adjective?
options: She is more tall than him
She is most taller than him

quiz.q: Which phrase describes a physical appearance trait?

chapters.title: Giving Instructions and Procedure Texts
paragraphs: Procedure texts explain how to perform a task or operate equipment through a series of steps. These texts typically start with a goal, followed by a list of materials, and conclude with sequential instructions. Use imperative verbs such as turn, press, connect, or insert to give clear commands.

Sequence markers like first, second, next, then, and finally help organize the steps logically. These words guide the reader through the process so they do not miss any critical actions. Proper sequencing prevents errors when following technical instructions.

Imperative sentences are formed by placing the base verb at the beginning of the sentence without a subject. For example, Connect the power cable to the outlet is a direct instruction. This style is concise and eliminates ambiguity in manual tasks.

When writing procedures, use technical nouns to identify specific parts or components. Words like screwdriver, circuit, terminal, or power supply provide clarity for the operator. Always ensure that the terminology is consistent throughout the document.

Follow this procedure to start the machine. First, check the power supply connection. Next, press the green button to activate the system. Finally, wait for the indicator light to turn blue before starting your work.

quiz.q: What is the primary purpose of a procedure text?

chapters.title: Recounting Past Events and Experiences
paragraphs: Recount texts retell past events in chronological order to inform or entertain the reader. These texts focus on personal experiences, such as a field trip or an internship project. Use the simple past tense to describe actions that were completed at a specific time.

The simple past tense is formed by adding -ed to regular verbs or using irregular verb forms. Examples include worked, visited, went, and saw. Establishing the timeframe with phrases like yesterday, last week, or two months ago is essential.

Conjunctions such as because, so, and although help link ideas within a recount. They explain the relationship between events, such as why a delay occurred or how a problem was solved. Use these to create a coherent narrative flow.

A recount text typically begins with an orientation that introduces the participants, the setting, and the time. This provides the necessary background for the reader to understand the subsequent events. Clear orientation ensures that the context is established immediately.

Last month, I completed my first internship at a local workshop. I learned how to repair small engines and worked with a team of skilled technicians. Although the tasks were challenging, I finished the project on time.

chapters.title: Descriptive Reports on Technical Objects
paragraphs: Report texts provide factual information about general categories, such as types of machinery, materials, or scientific concepts. Unlike descriptive texts about specific people, reports describe the general characteristics of a subject. Use the simple present tense to state facts that are generally true.

Technical reports often use passive voice to focus on the object rather than the person performing the action. For instance, the phrase The engine is cooled by oil focuses on the function of the oil. Passive voice is frequently used in scientific and technical documentation.

Classification is a key element of a report, where the object is defined and categorized. Use language such as is a type of, belongs to the family of, or is classified as to organize information. This helps the reader understand the broader context of the subject.

Include details about parts, functions, and usage to provide a comprehensive overview of the object. Use descriptive adjectives and technical vocabulary to ensure accuracy. Avoid subjective opinions, as reports must remain objective and informative.

The multimeter is a common electronic measuring instrument. It is used to measure voltage, current, and resistance in electrical circuits. This device is essential for technicians when troubleshooting electronic systems.

chapters.title: Narrative Stories and Workplace Lessons
paragraphs: Narrative texts tell stories involving characters, a setting, and a conflict that leads to a resolution. While often fictional, workplace narratives can highlight lessons about teamwork, problem-solving, or safety. These stories use the past tense to describe the sequence of events.

Every narrative requires a complication, which is the main problem the characters must face. The climax follows, representing the highest point of tension in the story. Finally, the resolution shows how the characters overcome the conflict.

Use dialogue to bring characters to life and show their reactions to the situation. Direct speech uses quotation marks and reporting verbs like said, asked, or replied. This makes the narrative more engaging and realistic for the reader.

Adverbs of manner, such as carefully, quickly, or silently, describe how the characters perform actions. These words add depth to the narrative by showing the characters' attitudes or the intensity of the scene. They enrich the description of events.

The young apprentice worked silently as he repaired the broken circuit. Suddenly, the machine started to spark, but he quickly turned off the power. He learned that safety is the most important part of any task.

chapters.title: Expressing Future Plans and Intentions
paragraphs: Expressing future plans involves using the future simple tense with will or the be going to structure. Use will for spontaneous decisions or predictions, while be going to is for planned actions. Both forms are essential for discussing upcoming projects or career goals.

The structure be going to is formed by combining the verb to be with going to and the base form of the verb. For example, I am going to study mechanical engineering next year. This expresses a clear intention and preparation.

Will is used for promises, offers, or sudden decisions made at the moment of speaking. If you decide to help a colleague, you might say, I will help you with that task. It indicates readiness and willingness to act.

Time markers such as tomorrow, next week, or in the future help clarify when the planned action will occur. These markers give context to your intentions and help in scheduling tasks. Consistent use of time markers improves communication efficiency.

Next month, our class is going to visit a large automotive factory. We will observe the assembly line and learn about modern production techniques. I hope that this visit will help me decide on my future career path.

chapters.title: Modal Verbs for Workplace Ability
paragraphs: Modal verbs such as can, could, should, and must are used to express ability, necessity, or advice. In a vocational context, these verbs define what a student is capable of doing or what safety regulations require. They modify the main verb to add specific meaning.

Use can to express present ability or possibility. For example, I can operate the lathe machine means you have the skill to do it. Use could to express past ability or a polite request for assistance.

Must indicates a strong necessity or obligation, often used for safety rules. You must wear safety goggles in the workshop is a clear requirement. Failure to follow these rules can lead to accidents or injury.

Should is used to provide advice or recommendation. If you are unsure about a procedure, you should ask your supervisor for clarification. This helps maintain professional standards and prevents errors in the workplace.

As a student, you can learn many technical skills. You must follow all safety procedures to protect yourself. If you have questions, you should always consult your instructor before starting a new task.

chapters.title: Describing Processes and Flowcharts
paragraphs: Describing processes requires understanding how different steps connect to form a complete system. Use transition words like meanwhile, simultaneously, and subsequently to show how events overlap or follow one another. This is crucial for explaining complex technical workflows.

Flowcharts represent processes visually, and describing them involves explaining the movement from one stage to the next. Use directional verbs like flow, move, enter, or exit to describe the process path. This makes technical explanations easier to follow.

Passive voice is essential when describing industrial processes where the object is the focus. The material is heated, then it is shaped, and finally it is cooled. This structure maintains the focus on the product rather than the worker.

Use conditional sentences with if or when to describe what happens under specific circumstances. For example, If the temperature exceeds the limit, the sensor triggers an alarm. This explains cause-and-effect relationships within a technical system.

When the raw material enters the machine, it is processed under high pressure. If the output is correct, it moves to the packaging stage. Simultaneously, the quality control team monitors the entire workflow.

chapters.title: Professional Communication and Workplace Etiquette
paragraphs: Professional communication involves using appropriate language and tone in workplace interactions. Whether in emails, meetings, or face-to-face discussions, clarity and politeness are paramount. Use formal greetings and closing remarks to maintain professional boundaries.

When writing emails, keep the message concise and focused on the purpose. Use a clear subject line, a professional salutation, and a polite sign-off. Avoid using slang or overly casual language that might be misinterpreted by colleagues.

Active listening is a critical component of communication, showing that you understand the information provided. Use phrases like I understand, Could you explain that again, or That is a good point to engage in the conversation. This fosters better teamwork.

Giving and receiving feedback requires a professional approach to ensure growth. When giving feedback, be specific and constructive rather than critical. When receiving it, listen openly and ask for examples if you need further clarification on how to improve.
Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to confirm our meeting on Tuesday. I have prepared the report as requested and will bring it to the office. Thank you for your time and guidance on this project.

chapters.title: Professional Correspondence and Email Etiquette
paragraphs: Formal emails require specific structural components including a clear subject line, a professional salutation, and a concise body. You should use formal openings like Dear Mr. Smith or Dear Hiring Manager to maintain professional standards.
The body of your email must state the purpose clearly in the first paragraph. Avoid using slang or abbreviations to ensure your message remains professional and respectful in a workplace environment.

Closing an email properly is essential for leaving a positive impression on the recipient. Phrases such as Sincerely, Best regards, or Respectfully are standard options for professional communication.
Attachments should be mentioned within the text to ensure the recipient knows to look for them. Use sentences like Please find the attached document for your review to guide the reader effectively.

Proofreading your email before hitting send prevents errors that could undermine your professional credibility. Check for grammatical accuracy and ensure your tone aligns with the context of your message.

chapters.title: Describing Workplace Products and Equipment
paragraphs: Descriptive texts in a technical context focus on the physical attributes and functional utility of specific equipment. You use adjectives like durable, ergonomic, or high-performance to explain why a tool is effective for a task.

The structure of a description typically starts with an identification of the object followed by a detailed description of its features. This sequence helps the reader visualize the item clearly before understanding its application.

Using specific terminology related to your industry makes your descriptions accurate and professional. For example, describing a motor as having a high torque output provides more value than simply saying it is strong.

Comparative adjectives are useful when you need to distinguish between different models of equipment. Phrases such as more efficient than or the most reliable option help clients make informed decisions.

Sensory details and technical specifications combine to create a comprehensive overview of a product. Focus on dimensions, material composition, and key functions to provide a complete picture for the user.

chapters.title: Mastering Standard Operating Procedures
paragraphs: Procedure texts provide step-by-step instructions for completing a specific task safely and efficiently. You must use imperative verbs such as insert, rotate, connect, or press to give clear commands.

A logical sequence is the foundation of any procedure, usually organized by numbered steps or chronological markers. Use transition words like first, then, next, and finally to guide the reader through the process.

Safety warnings are critical components of technical procedures and should be highlighted using phrases like Caution, Warning, or Danger. These alerts prevent accidents and ensure the equipment remains in good working condition.
Clear and concise language is necessary to prevent misunderstanding during complex technical operations. Avoid ambiguous terms and focus on direct actions that result in the desired outcome.
The conclusion of a procedure often includes a verification step to ensure the task was completed successfully. You might say verify the connection or test the system to confirm proper operation.

chapters.title: Reporting Technical Incidents and Progress
paragraphs: A report text presents factual information about a specific event, project status, or technical incident. You must maintain an objective tone and avoid personal opinions to ensure the report remains professional.

Reports typically follow a structured format including an introduction, findings, and a conclusion. The introduction outlines the background of the situation, while the findings provide the detailed data collected.
Passive voice is frequently used in technical reports to focus on the action rather than the person performing it. For example, the machine was inspected is preferred over I inspected the machine.

Data visualization through bullet points or tables helps organize complex information for the reader. This allows stakeholders to quickly identify key facts or issues without reading lengthy paragraphs.

The conclusion of a report should offer a summary of the situation and, if necessary, recommendations for future actions. Keep these recommendations specific and actionable based on the findings presented earlier.

chapters.title: Narrating Professional Work Experiences
paragraphs: Recount texts are used to share past work experiences or project histories in a chronological order. You use past tense verbs like completed, managed, solved, and developed to describe your actions.
The orientation part of a recount introduces the setting, the people involved, and the purpose of the experience. This provides the context necessary for the reader to understand the narrative.

Events are presented sequentially, often using temporal conjunctions such as after that, subsequently, or meanwhile. These markers help the reader follow the flow of your work history without confusion.
Including specific outcomes or lessons learned adds value to your recount, especially in a professional portfolio. Describe how you overcame challenges to demonstrate your problem-solving skills.

The re-orientation or closing section provides a personal reflection or a summary of the experience. This section ties the narrative together and highlights the significance of the event in your career.

chapters.title: Effective Workplace Presentation Skills
paragraphs: Presentations require clear organization and the use of signposting language to guide the audience. Start with an introduction that states your topic and outlines the key points you will cover.

Signposting phrases such as Moving on to the next point, Let us look at the data, or In conclusion help the audience track your progress. These transitions prevent the presentation from feeling disjointed.
Visual aids should be simple, containing minimal text and high-quality graphics to support your verbal message. Avoid reading directly from your slides as this reduces engagement with your audience.

Body language and vocal variety significantly impact how your message is received by listeners. Maintain eye contact and use a steady pace to appear confident and knowledgeable about your subject matter.

The question-and-answer session at the end of a presentation allows for clarification and deeper discussion. Prepare for potential questions by anticipating the most common concerns related to your topic.

chapters.title: Negotiating and Expressing Opinions
paragraphs: Negotiation involves expressing your perspective while remaining open to the views of others. Use polite phrases like I see your point, but..., or From my perspective, to introduce your opinions.
Active listening is just as important as speaking during a negotiation process. Summarize what the other person said to show you understand their position before proposing your own solution.
Modal verbs such as could, would, and might are essential for making suggestions without sounding too aggressive. These verbs soften your language and make your requests easier for others to accept.
Compromise is often the goal of workplace negotiation, requiring both parties to give and take. Use phrases like I am willing to agree if... to reach a mutually beneficial arrangement.
Maintaining a professional tone, even when you disagree, is crucial for preserving workplace relationships. Focus on the issue at hand rather than attacking the person holding the opposing view.

chapters.title: Analyzing Workplace Trends and Data
paragraphs: Analytical texts examine current industry trends and data to provide insights for decision making. You use vocabulary related to growth, decline, and stability, such as fluctuate, stabilize, or surge.
Describing trends requires the use of specific adverbs and adjectives to provide precision. Phrases like a sharp increase or a steady decline help clarify the magnitude of the change observed.
Comparisons between different periods allow you to identify patterns in the data. Use time markers like compared to last quarter or over the past year to anchor your analysis in time.
Charts and graphs serve as the primary evidence in analytical reports. When writing, refer directly to these visuals using phrases like As shown in the chart or According to the data.
The conclusion of an analysis should highlight the implications of the trends for your organization. Connect the data to potential future actions to demonstrate the practical value of your analysis.

chapters.title: Writing Effective Job Applications
paragraphs: A strong cover letter highlights your skills and experiences that are relevant to the specific job position. Start by stating the role you are applying for and why you are interested in the company.
Your resume should be formatted with clear headings such as Work Experience, Education, and Skills. Use action verbs to describe your responsibilities and achievements in previous roles.

Tailoring your application documents to the job description increases your chances of getting an interview. Use keywords found in the job advertisement to show that you meet the employer's requirements.

Professionalism in your application includes using a standard font and correct grammar throughout the document. Avoid using overly casual language that might be perceived as unprofessional by recruiters.
The closing of your cover letter should express enthusiasm and request an interview. Thank the employer for their time and consideration, providing your contact information for easy follow-up.

chapters.title: Interpreting Workplace Safety Regulations
paragraphs: Workplace safety regulations are written to ensure a secure environment for all employees. Use modal verbs of obligation such as must, have to, and should to describe mandatory safety rules.
Prohibition is expressed using phrases like must not or are not allowed to. These are critical for preventing dangerous behaviors that could lead to workplace accidents.
Safety signage uses specific colors and symbols to communicate hazards instantly. Understand the meaning behind icons like fire extinguishers, exit signs, and protective gear requirements.
Reporting safety incidents involves clear and accurate documentation of what happened and where. Use descriptive language to explain the cause of the incident without assigning blame.
Compliance with safety standards is a continuous process that requires regular training and updates. Stay informed about new regulations to maintain a safe and productive workplace.

chapters.title: Self Introduction and Personal Pronouns
paragraphs: Unsur utama dalam memperkenalkan diri mencakup salam, nama, asal, serta kegemaran. Ungkapan "Let me introduce myself, my name is Rahma" digunakan dalam situasi formal, sedangkan "Hi, I am Rahma" dipakai dalam situasi informal.

Kata ganti orang atau pronouns terbagi menjadi subject pronoun, object pronoun, possessive adjective, dan possessive pronoun. Kalimat "She gave me her book because this book is hers" menunjukkan perubahan bentuk pronoun berdasarkan kedudukannya dalam struktur bahasa.

Tata bahasa utama dalam perkenalan adalah Simple Present Tense untuk menyatakan fakta tentang diri sendiri. Formula dasar untuk kalimat verbal adalah Subject + Verb 1 (s/es), seperti pada kalimat "My father works as an engineer in Surabaya."

Kosakata yang sering digunakan mencakup kata sifat kepribadian seperti friendly, outgoing, humble, dan hardworking. Sebagai contoh, kalimat "Siti is a humble student who always helps her classmates" memuat kata sifat yang menggambarkan watak seseorang.
Dialog perkenalan biasanya diakhiri dengan salam penutup untuk mengakhiri pembicaraan secara sopan. Ungkapan "Nice to meet you" dijawab dengan "Nice to meet you too" sebagai bentuk kesopanan sosial.

chapters.title: Descriptive Text and Noun Phrases
paragraphs: Teks deskriptif memuat dua struktur utama, yaitu identification dan description. Bagian identification mengenalkan objek yang digambarkan, sedangkan bagian description merincikan ciri-ciri fisik, sifat, atau karakter objek tersebut.

Pembuatan noun phrase menggabungkan modifier dan head noun untuk menggambarkan objek secara spesifik. Contoh noun phrase adalah "a talented young Indonesian badminton player" di mana kata "player" merupakan kata benda utama atau head noun.

Kata sifat deskriptif digunakan untuk menggambarkan penampilan fisik seperti tall, muscular, short hair, dan oval face. Kalimat "Anthony Ginting has a lean body and exceptional agility on the court" menggambarkan atribut fisik atlet secara spesifik.

Teks deskriptif tempat bersejarah menggunakan kosakata spesifik terkait lokasi dan arsitektur, seperti ancient, majestic, heritage, dan structure. Kalimat "Borobudur is a majestic ninth-century Buddhist temple located in Magelang" memberikan deskripsi lokasi dan bangunan.

Penggunaan Simple Present Tense mutlak digunakan pada teks deskriptif untuk menyampaikan fakta objektif. Kalimat "The National Monument stands 132 meters tall in the center of Jakarta" menunjukkan fakta yang konstan dan tidak berubah.

chapters.title: Personal Recounts and Simple Past
paragraphs: Teks recount bertujuan menceritakan kembali peristiwa masa lalu secara runtut berdasarkan urutan waktu. Struktur utamanya terdiri dari orientation, series of events, dan reorientation.

Bagian orientation memberikan informasi latar belakang mengenai siapa, di mana, dan kapan peristiwa tersebut terjadi. Contoh kalimat orientation adalah "Last holiday, my family and I visited Parangtritis Beach in Yogyakarta."

Simple Past Tense digunakan untuk menyatakan aksi yang selesai di masa lalu menggunakan kata kerja bentuk kedua. Kata kerja beraturan menambahkan akhiran -ed seperti "walked", sedangkan kata kerja tidak beraturan berubah bentuk seperti "went" dan "bought".

Adverb of time dan time connectives seperti first, next, then, after that, dan finally mengurutkan peristiwa secara kronologis. Kalimat "First, we bought the entrance tickets, and then we walked toward the shore" menghubungkan kejadian secara jelas.

Bagian reorientation berisi kesan personal atau kesimpulan penulis terhadap pengalaman tersebut. Kalimat "It was an exhausting day, but we felt extremely happy with our holiday experience" menutup teks recount dengan evaluasi pribadi.

options: To retell past events or experiences
To explain how to operate something
To convince readers about an issue
To describe a person in detail

chapters.title: Procedure Text and Imperative Verbs
paragraphs: Teks prosedur memberikan petunjuk langkah demi langkah untuk membuat sesuatu atau menyelesaikan suatu aktivitas. Struktur umum teks prosedur meliputi goal, materials atau ingredients, serta steps atau methods.

Kalimat perintah atau imperative sentences digunakan tanpa subjek untuk memberi arahan langsung. Contoh imperative sentences antara lain "Chop the garlic finely" dan "Boil the water for five minutes."

Adverbs of sequence berfungsi memberi petunjuk urutan langkah pekerjaan secara rinci. Kata-kata seperti first, secondly, after that, dan finally mengarahkan pembaca agar tidak tertukar dalam menjalankan proses.
Penggunaan action verbs atau kata kerja aksi sangat dominan dalam penjelasan petunjuk cara kerja. Kata kerja seperti stir, mix, cut, pour, dan slice merupakan contoh kata kerja tindakan konkret.

Teks prosedur kesehatan menekankan pengukuran serta waktu presisi agar hasil yang dicapai aman. Kalimat "Wash your hands thoroughly with soap for at least twenty seconds" memberikan instruksi spesifik mengenai durasi dan tindakan.

quiz.q: What is the purpose of a procedure text?
options: To explain how to make or do something step-by-step

quiz.q: Which element of a procedure text lists tools or items needed?

chapters.title: Factual Report Text and Passive Voice
paragraphs: Teks report menyajikan informasi faktual secara umum berdasarkan hasil pengamatan ilmiah. Struktur dasarnya terdiri dari general classification yang menggolongkan subjek, serta description yang merinci karakteristik ilmiahnya.

Perbedaan teks report dan deskriptif terletak pada cakupan subjek yang dibahas. Teks deskriptif membahas satu objek spesifik seperti "My Cat", sedangkan teks report membahas kelas objek secara umum seperti "Cats".

Passive voice sering digunakan dalam teks report untuk menekankan fokus pada objek atau fenomena daripada pelaku tindakan. Rumus dasar passive voice adalah Subject + to be + Verb 3, seperti pada kalimat "Photosynthesis is performed by green plants."
Teks report memuat istilah teknis atau ilmiah yang relevan dengan topik yang disajikan. Contoh kosakata ilmiah pada pembahasan hewan antara lain nocturnal, mammal, habitat, predator, dan carnivore.

Penggunaan Simple Present Tense dengan kata kerja relasional menyatakan kebenaran umum dan fakta alami. Kalimat "Whales belong to the group of marine mammals that breathe air through blowholes" mengungkapkan fakta biologi universal.

quiz.q: How does a report text differ from a descriptive text?
options: Report texts describe things in general, while descriptive texts describe specific things.
Report texts use simple past tense, while descriptive texts use simple future.
Report texts tell fictional stories, while descriptive texts give instructions.
Report texts express personal opinions, while descriptive texts retell experiences.

quiz.q: What is the first generic structure of a report text?
Change this sentence to passive voice: 'Plants absorb water from the soil.'
options: Water absorbed plants from the soil.
Water is absorbed by plants from the soil.
Water absorbs plants from the soil.
Soil is absorbed by water from plants.

quiz.q: Which word is a technical term related to biology?
Complete the sentence: 'Tigers ____ classified as carnivorous mammals.'
What does the scientific term 'nocturnal' mean?

chapters.title: Analytical Exposition and Opinion Expressions
paragraphs: Teks eksposisi analitis bertujuan meyakinkan pembaca bahwa suatu isu penting untuk dibahas melalui argumen logis. Teks ini memiliki tiga bagian utama, yaitu thesis, arguments, dan reiteration.

Bagian thesis memuat sudut pandang atau posisi penulis terhadap topik yang dibicarakan. Contoh kalimat thesis adalah "Online learning plays a crucial role in modern education due to its accessibility and flexibility."

Bagian arguments menyajikan alasan pendukung yang disertai fakta, data, atau bukti nyata. Kalimat "Furthermore, digital resources allow students to access learning materials anywhere and at any time" memperkuat poin argumen.

Kalimat reiteration menegaskan kembali posisi penulis di akhir teks tanpa mengubah gagasan utama. Ungkapan penutup seperti "In conclusion, maintaining a balanced lifestyle is essential for overall health" merangkum poin pembahasannya.

Kata hubung sebab-akibat seperti cause, because of, due to, consequently, dan therefore menghubungkan antarklausa argumen. Kalimat "Due to high traffic congestion, public transport must be prioritized in urban areas" memperlihatkan hubungan sebab akibat yang jelas.

quiz.q: What is the primary purpose of an analytical exposition text?
options: To entertain readers with a story
To persuade readers that a topic is important through logical arguments
To describe a specific person or place

quiz.q: What are the three generic structures of an analytical exposition?
Which phrase is used to introduce a personal opinion?
Complete the sentence: 'The event was cancelled ____ heavy rain.'
What is the main function of the reiteration section?
options: To restate the writer's thesis or position

quiz.q: Which conjunction expresses a cause-and-effect relationship?

chapters.title: Narrative Text and Past Continuous
paragraphs: Teks naratif berfokus pada cerita rekaan atau hiburan yang melibatkan konflik dan penyelesaian masalah. Struktur generiknya mencakup orientation, complication, resolution, dan sering diakhiri re-orientation.

Bagian complication memperkenalkan permasalahan atau krisis yang dialami oleh tokoh utama cerita. Contoh kalimat complication adalah "One day, a severe drought hit the village and threatened the harvest."

Bagian resolution memuat cara tokoh menyelesaikan konflik tersebut, baik berakhir bahagia maupun sedih. Kalimat "The prince successfully defeated the dragon and brought peace back to the kingdom" menunjukkan penyelesaian masalah.

Past Continuous Tense digunakan untuk menggambarkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat kejadian lain terjadi di masa lalu. Rumusnya adalah Subject + was/were + Verb-ing, seperti pada kalimat "Sangkuriang was building a boat when the sun rose."

Kosakata sastra dan ungkapan waktu klasik seperti once upon a time, long ago, dan suddenly memperkuat nuansa penceritaan. Kalimat "Once upon a time, there lived a poor fisherman near a giant lake" membuka cerita naratif dengan konteks tempat dan waktu lampau.

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of a narrative text?
options: To entertain readers with a story involving a conflict
To argue about a controversial issue

quiz.q: What stage introduces the problem or conflict in a narrative text?
Complete the sentence: 'While Malin Kundang ____ on the sea, his mother waited on the shore.'
Which generic structure contains the solution to the story's conflict?
What formula is used for the Past Continuous Tense?
Choose the phrase typically used to start a narrative story:

chapters.title: Congratulating and Complimenting Others
paragraphs: Ungkapan ucapan selamat atau congratulation disampaikan untuk mengapresiasi pencapaian atau momen bahagia seseorang. Ungkapan populer meliputi "Congratulations on your graduation!" dan "I am proud of your achievements."

Ungkapan pujian atau complimenting digunakan untuk memberikan pujian atas penampilan, kemampuan, atau hasil kerja seseorang. Struktur kalimat pujian sering menggunakan pola "What a + adjective + noun!" seperti "What a beautiful performance!"

Tanggapan atas ucapan selamat dan pujian harus disampaikan secara sopan menggunakan ungkapan terima kasih. Contoh respon balasan yang tepat adalah "Thank you very much, it is very kind of you to say so."

Present Perfect Tense sering digunakan saat memberi ucapan selamat untuk menyatakan tindakan yang baru saja diselesaikan dengan sukses. Rumusnya adalah Subject + have/has + Verb 3, seperti pada kalimat "You have done a great job on the competition."

Kartu ucapan selamat atau congratulation card memuat penerima, pesan spesifik, dan pengirim pesan. Kalimat "Dear Siti, congratulations on winning the English debate championship, warmest regards from Budi" memuat struktur kartu ucapan lengkap.

quiz.q: What is the appropriate response to 'Congratulations on winning first prize!'?
options: I am sorry to hear that.

quiz.q: Which sentence is a compliment using the 'What a...' structure?
Complete the sentence: 'You ____ achieved the highest score in the final exam.'
Which expression is used to congratulate someone?
options: I am sorry for your loss.
I would like to congratulate you on your success.
I do not agree with you.

quiz.q: In 'What an amazing achievement', what part of speech is 'amazing'?
What is the main purpose of a congratulation card?
options: To convey good wishes and praise for someone's success
To invite someone to a fight
To complain about a bad service

chapters.title: Functional Texts and Modal Auxiliaries
paragraphs: Teks fungsional pendek seperti pengumuman atau announcement memberikan informasi resmi kepada publik secara singkat dan jelas. Struktur pengumuman memuat judul acara, tujuan, waktu, tempat, dan kontak penanggung jawab.

Kalimat dalam pengumuman harus bersifat informatif dan langsung pada inti masalah tanpa berbelit-belit. Kalimat "The school library will be closed on Friday due to annual inventory stock taking" menyampaikan informasi operasional secara lugas.

Modal auxiliaries seperti must, should, can, dan may digunakan untuk menyatakan keharusan, saran, atau izin. Kalimat "All students must submit their assignments before three o'clock in the afternoon" menggunakan "must" untuk menunjukkan kewajiban mutlak.

Teks notice dan caution memberikan instruksi singkat atau peringatan keamanan di area umum. Kalimat "Caution: Wet floor, please walk carefully" memberi arahan bahaya yang mudah dipahami dalam waktu singkat.

Kosakata resmi seperti register, participate, mandatory, require, dan attend sering muncul dalam pengumuman sekolah. Kalimat "All participants are required to attend the briefing session in the hall" memuat istilah formal dalam instruksi publik.

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of an announcement text?
options: To inform people about an event or important notice

quiz.q: Which modal auxiliary expresses a strong obligation?
Complete the sentence: 'Visitors ____ not take photos inside the museum.'
What information is usually found in an event announcement?
options: Date, time, venue, and contact person

quiz.q: What does the notice 'Caution: Slippery when wet' warn you about?
options: A slippery surface that could cause falling

quiz.q: What is the synonym of the word 'mandatory'?

chapters.title: Songs Interpretation and Figurative Language
paragraphs: Lagu merupakan karya seni yang mengombinasikan lirik dan musik untuk menyampaikan pesan emosional atau kritik sosial. Memahami lirik lagu memerlukan analisis terhadap tema, suasana hati, pesan moral, dan majas.

Bahasa kiasan atau figurative language seperti simile, metaphor, dan personification sering dipakai dalam penulisan lirik. Simile membandingkan dua hal menggunakan kata "like" atau "as", contohnya "My love is like a red rose."

Metafora atau metaphor membandingkan dua hal secara langsung tanpa kata penghubung seperti "like" atau "as". Kalimat "You are my sunshine on a rainy day" merupakan contoh metafora yang menggambarkan seseorang sebagai sumber kebahagiaan.
Personifikasi memberikan sifat manusia kepada benda mati atau ide abstrak di dalam lirik lagu. Contoh kalimat personifikasi dalam lirik adalah "The wind whispers secrets through the night sky."
Rima atau rhyme scheme menambah nilai estetika dan irama pada bait-bait lagu. Analisis lirik membantu pendengar memahami makna tersirat yang ingin disampaikan oleh penulis lagu secara lebih mendalam.

quiz.q: What figurative language compares two things using 'like' or 'as'?
Identify the metaphor among the options:
options: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
Time is a thief that steals our moments.
The trees danced in the wind.
She is like a shining star.

quiz.q: In 'The stars danced in the dark night', which figurative language is used?
What is the main theme of a song that discusses helping each other and unity?
What element creates a harmonious pattern of sounds at the end of lyric lines?
What does 'interpreting a song' mean?
options: Understanding the deeper meaning and message behind the lyrics

chapters.title: Teks Eksposisi Analitis dan Argumentasi
paragraphs: Analytical exposition text bertujuan meyakinkan pembaca bahwa topik yang diangkat memiliki urgensi atau sudut pandang kritis tertentu. Teks ini diawali oleh thesis statement yang menyatakan posisi penulis secara eksplisit, misalnya 'Digital literacy is an indispensable skill for navigating modern disinformation.' Kalimat pembuka harus menetapkan batasan topik yang jelas tanpa menyisakan ambiguitas bagi pembaca.

Struktur teks eksposisi analitis terdiri atas thesis, series of arguments, dan reiteration. Setiap paragraf argumen diawali oleh topic sentence yang memuat satu ide pendukung, seperti 'Firstly, critical evaluation of online sources prevents the uncritical spread of falsehoods.' Penulis menyertakan elaborasi berupa fakta empiris atau data statistik untuk memperkuat validitas klaim tersebut.

Unsur kebahasaan teks ini berakar pada penggunaan simple present tense dan kata kerja mental seperti 'believe', 'assume', dan 'conclude'. Selain itu, evaluative language digunakan secara terukur untuk mempertegas derajat kepentingan argumen, contohnya kata sifat 'crucial', 'detrimental', atau 'paramount'. Pilihan kata ini membangun nuansa analitis yang objektif.

Kohesi antargagasan dibangun melalui conjunctions of addition dan contrast, seperti 'furthermore', 'moreover', dan 'in contrast'. Penggunaan kalimat kompleks dengan klausa dependen memperlihatkan penalaran logis, misalnya 'Although social media accelerates information exchange, it lacks systematic verification mechanisms.' Struktur ini menghubungkan sebab dan akibat secara terpadu.

Bagian reiteration merumuskan ulang ide pokok dalam thesis menggunakan variasi parafrasa, bukan sekadar pengulangan kata demi kata secara harfiah. Contoh perumusannya adalah 'In conclusion, acquiring media verification skills is imperative to preserve democratic discourse.' Penulis tidak menambahkan argumen baru pada bagian penutup ini.

quiz.q: What is the primary function of a thesis statement in an analytical exposition text?
options: To present the writer's central position clearly
To entertain the reader with an imaginative story
To provide a step-by-step instruction manual
To describe the physical traits of an object

quiz.q: Which sentence functions as an effective topic sentence for an argument paragraph?
options: Yesterday, my friend forwarded an unverified news article to my phone.
Once upon a time, people relied entirely on daily printed newspapers.
Firstly, digital literacy prevents users from circulating damaging hoaxes.
I will conclude this essay by asking everyone to buy a computer.

quiz.q: Choose the evaluative word that indicates high importance in academic writing.
Which transitional word functions to add an argument that supports the previous claim?
How should a reiteration paragraph be formulated properly?
options: By restating the thesis statement using paraphrased language
By introducing completely new factual arguments and case studies
By asking open-ended questions without resolving them
By retelling personal past experiences chronologically

quiz.q: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of simple present tense in an analytical argument?
options: Online platforms were operating without any editorial supervision last century.
The rapid dissemination of digital data demands rigorous scrutiny from users.
They will have downloaded the application tomorrow afternoon.
She was reading three articles simultaneously when the power failed.

chapters.title: Ungkapan Opini dan Sikap Argumentatif
paragraphs: Penyampaian pendapat dalam konteks formal menuntut pemilihan register bahasa yang menunjukkan kesantunan serta ketegasan sikap. Ungkapan seperti 'From my perspective,...' atau 'I am inclined to believe that...' lebih diutamakan daripada pernyataan informal yang terlalu ringkas. Frasa tersebut menandai bahwa penutur mengemukakan pertimbangan yang telah dipikirkan matang.

Persetujuan penuh dapat diungkapkan menggunakan idiom formal seperti 'I could not agree more' atau frasa 'I share the same conviction on this matter.' Sebaliknya, persetujuan bersyarat membutuhkan penanda nuansa seperti 'I concede that your point is valid, yet we must consider the budget constraints.' Penanda transisi ini menunjukkan bahwa penutur menghargai argumen lawan sebelum memberikan batasan.

Ketidaksetujuan formal disampaikan tanpa konfrontasi emosional lewat ungkapan mitigatif seperti 'I respectfully disagree with that assertion.' Pola lain yang kerap digunakan adalah 'With all due respect, the evidence does not entirely substantiate that claim.' Pendekatan ini memisahkan sanggahan terhadap ide dari penilaian terhadap pribadi lawan bicara.

Modal adverbs digunakan untuk mengukur derajat kepastian suatu proposisi secara presisi, contohnya 'arguably', 'presumably', dan 'undoubtedly'. Contoh pemakaiannya adalah 'This policy is arguably the most progressive reform in decades.' Kata keterangan ini menentukan apakah suatu klaim diposisikan sebagai kepastian mutlak atau kemungkinan yang terukur.

Pertanyaan penegas sikap sering disisipkan untuk meminta klarifikasi lawan bicara dalam sesi debat, misalnya 'What is your stance regarding the ethical implications of this technology?' Penutur dapat menanggapi pertanyaan tersebut dengan 'I take the position that regulation must precede deployment.' Percakapan argumentatif menuntut pertukaran klaim dan alasan yang runtut.

quiz.q: Which expression demonstrates polite disagreement in a formal academic debate?
options: You are completely wrong about the facts.
That statement makes no sense whatsoever.
I respectfully disagree with that assertion.
I demand that you retract your statement immediately.

quiz.q: What does the speaker convey by saying: 'I concede your point, yet we must consider the logistical constraints'?
options: Total rejection of the opposing idea
Partial agreement with an added condition
Lack of knowledge about the main subject

quiz.q: Which modal adverb indicates the highest degree of certainty in a statement?
Choose the most appropriate phrase to initiate a well-reasoned personal opinion.
What is the function of the phrase 'I could not agree more'?
options: Expressing complete agreement with the interlocutor
Showing hesitation and refusal to decide

quiz.q:
Complete the dialogue with the most suitable formal question:
A: ________________________
B: 'I maintain the stance that sustainability criteria should be legally enforced.'
options: Where did you buy those technical books?
What is your stance regarding environmental regulations?
Can you tell me the departure time of the train?
Why did the team cancel the exhibition yesterday?

chapters.title: Teks Eksposisi Hortatori dan Rekomendasi
paragraphs: Hortatory exposition text difokuskan untuk memengaruhi pembaca agar melakukan tindakan tertentu atau menghindari perbuatan yang merugikan. Perbedaan fundamental teks ini dibandingkan eksposisi analitis terletak pada bagian akhirnya yang memuat recommendation, bukan reiteration. Penulis memformulasikan solusi praktis atas isu sosial, lingkungan, atau kesehatan yang dianalisis.

Tahapan struktural teks hortatori mencakup thesis, serangkaian arguments, dan recommendation pada paragraf pemungkas. Argumen disusun secara hirarkis dari bukti yang paling persuasif hingga dampak sistemik jika tindakan tidak segera diambil. Kalimat seperti 'Failure to reform waste management will cause irreversible groundwater contamination' membangun urgensi tindakan.

Ciri gramatika yang dominan adalah pemakaian modal verbs of obligation seperti 'should', 'ought to', dan 'must'. Pola kalimat imperatif dan rekomendatif formal sering menggunakan bentuk 'It is imperative that schools implement zero-waste programs.' Kalimat ini menekankan keharusan moral atau praktis yang ditujukan kepada pemangku kepentingan.

Kata kerja tindakan (action verbs) berfrekuensi tinggi dalam rekomendasi teks hortatori, contohnya 'prohibit', 'subsidize', 'reinforce', dan 'adopt'. Penulis menghindari anjuran yang terlalu abstrak dengan menyajikan langkah spesifik, misalnya 'Municipalities ought to install solar panels on public buildings.' Kejelasan instruksi tindakan menentukan daya persuasi teks.

Hubungan persuasif diperkuat oleh connective devices yang bersifat instrumental seperti 'in order to', 'so that', dan 'thereby'. Contoh penerapannya adalah 'Governments should penalize illegal dumping so that corporate compliance increases.' Hubungan tujuan dan tindakan ini menunjukkan mekanisme logis di balik solusi yang diajukan.

quiz.q: What distinguishes a hortatory exposition from an analytical exposition text?
options: A hortatory exposition concludes with a recommendation for action.
An analytical exposition uses past tense as its main grammatical feature.
A hortatory exposition only describes fictional characters.
An analytical exposition always contains an imaginative narrative plot.

quiz.q: Which modal auxiliary expresses strong obligation in a hortatory recommendation?
Identify the sentence that correctly exemplifies a formal recommendation.
options: The committee held a marathon session yesterday afternoon.
Heavy rain flooded the residential sector near the riverbanks.
It is imperative that authorities regulate single-use plastics strictly.
Plastic waste has been floating across international waters for years.

quiz.q: Which word is an action verb commonly found in the recommendation section?
Choose the connector that establishes purpose between an action and its intended goal.
What is the primary objective of presenting arguments in a hortatory exposition?
options: To entertain the audience with dramatic events
To convince the audience that a specific action must be taken
To report raw numerical data without any evaluation
To describe the aesthetic beauty of an archaeological monument

chapters.title: Hubungan Kausalitas dan Konjungsi Sebab-Akibat
paragraphs: Pernyataan kausalitas dalam bahasa Inggris membedakan antara preposisi yang diikuti frasa nomina dan konjungsi yang diikuti klausa lengkap. Frasa preposisional 'because of', 'due to', dan 'owing to' harus diikuti noun phrase, contohnya 'The flight was cancelled due to severe atmospheric turbulence.' Kesalahan umum terjadi saat penutur meletakkan klausa berpredikat langsung setelah 'due to'.

Sebaliknya, subordinating conjunctions seperti 'because', 'since', dan 'as' berfungsi menggabungkan klausa dependen dengan klausa independen. Kalimat 'Since global sea levels are rising, coastal infrastructure requires extensive reinforcement' menempatkan sebab pada anak kalimat. Hubungan ini menunjukkan urutan logis bahwa kenaikan air laut memicu perlunya penguatan infrastruktur.

Transisi antarkalimat untuk menunjukkan akibat mencakup adverbia konjungtif seperti 'consequently', 'therefore', dan 'as a result'. Adverbia ini diletakkan di awal kalimat kedua dengan diikuti tanda koma, misalnya 'Prolonged droughts decimated crops; consequently, food prices surged dramatically.' Pola tanda baca ini menjaga kohesi antarkalimat majemuk.

Kausalitas juga dapat dinyatakan melalui kata kerja transitif seperti 'cause', 'trigger', 'lead to', dan 'result in'. Contoh formulasinya adalah 'Excessive industrial runoff leads to oxygen depletion in aquatic ecosystems.' Sebaliknya, untuk menyatakan sumber akibat, digunakan frasa kerja 'result from' atau 'stem from'.

Struktur kalimat inversi bersyarat dapat memperkuat penekanan hubungan sebab-akibat dalam wacana saintifik, seperti 'Only when emissions decrease will temperature stabilize.' Variasi sintaksis ini mencegah monotonitas struktur klausa sederhana. Pemahaman gramatika kausalitas mutlak diperlukan dalam penulisan ilmiah.

quiz.q: Which sentence demonstrates the grammatically correct usage of 'due to' followed by a noun phrase?
options: The harvest failed due to the rainfall was extremely scarce.
The event was postponed due to torrential rainfall in the afternoon.
Due to they arrived late, the lecture had already finished.
She achieved success due to she worked tirelessly every single day.

quiz.q: Choose the subordinating conjunction that introduces an adverbial clause of cause.
Which verb phrase correctly expresses that a cause leads forward to an effect?
Complete the sentence correctly: 'Urban traffic congestion escalated; ____________, commuter travel times doubled.'
What is the difference in syntactic function between 'because' and 'because of'?
options: 'Because' takes a noun phrase, whereas 'because of' introduces a full clause.
'Because' introduces a clause, whereas 'because of' is followed by a noun phrase.
Both words require a passive verb immediately following them.
Neither word can be used at the beginning of an English sentence.

quiz.q: Which sentence indicates that an effect arises from a specific prior origin?
options: The deforestation resulted in substantial soil degradation.
The flash floods stemmed from unprecedented alpine snowmelt.
Heavy rains caused widespread damage across the village.
The volcanic eruption triggered tremors throughout the valley.

chapters.title: Teks Eksplanasi Fenomena Alam dan Sosial
paragraphs: Explanation text berfungsi menguraikan proses pembentukan, cara kerja, atau alasan di balik terjadinya fenomena alam, ilmiah, maupun sosio-kultural. Teks ini tidak bertujuan membujuk atau menceritakan kisah fiktif, melainkan menyajikan penjelasan faktual yang objektif. Topik tipikal meliputi proses terjadinya aurora, siklus hidrologi, hingga fenomena inflasi moneter.

Struktur baku teks eksplanasi terbagi menjadi general statement yang mendefinisikan fenomena dan sequenced explanation yang mengurai tahapan kejadian. General statement membuka teks dengan definisi lugas, seperti 'A tsunami is a series of massive ocean waves caused by underwater geological disturbances.' Kalimat ini menetapkan subjek sebelum proses tahapan dijelaskan.

Ciri gramatika paling esensial dalam teks eksplanasi adalah dominasi passive voice untuk menekankan objek dan proses ketimbang pelaku tindakan. Contohnya adalah 'Magma is forced upward through fissures by immense subterranean pressure.' Subjek gramatikal dalam konstruksi pasif berfokus langsung pada material yang mengalami transformasi fisik.

Penanda urutan waktu dan proses (chronological and sequential connectors) digunakan untuk merangkai mata rantai peristiwa secara teratur. Frasa seperti 'subsequently', 'in the subsequent stage', dan 'prior to this' memandu alur pemahaman pembaca. Penanda ini memastikan bahwa hubungan sebab-akibat antarproses dapat ditelusuri dengan gamblang.

Kosakata teknis atau istilah ilmiah (technical terms) mendominasi leksikon teks eksplanasi sesuai ranah keilmuan yang dibahas. Pada teks tentang pembentukan hujan, istilah seperti 'evaporation', 'condensation', dan 'precipitation' wajib dipakai secara akurat. Penjelasan istilah teknis tersebut dibangun langsung melalui kalimat penjelas penyertainya.

quiz.q: What is the primary communicative purpose of an explanation text?
options: To persuade people to alter their daily habits
To narrate a myth using past actions and dialogue
To explain how or why a natural or social phenomenon happens
To give operational guidelines for running a technical machine

quiz.q: Identify the passive voice sentence appropriate for a scientific explanation text.
options: Water vapor is condensed into droplets when ambient temperature drops.
We saw heavy clouds drifting over the mountain range this morning.
The sky becomes darker before the sudden afternoon thunderstorm.
Children love watching colorful rainbows after torrential rain showers.

quiz.q: Which sequential transition indicates a following stage in a chronological process?
What information does the 'general statement' provide in an explanation text?
options: A personal emotional reaction to a natural tragedy
A final recommendation for readers to stay safe
A critical evaluation of modern scientific discoveries
A clear definition or identification of the phenomenon being explained

quiz.q: Which set of vocabulary belongs to an explanation text describing the water cycle?
Which conjunction effectively demonstrates a simultaneous process in an explanation?

chapters.title: Kalimat Pengandaian dan Klausa Subjungtif
paragraphs: Conditional sentences memetakan hubungan antara kondisi prasyarat dengan hasil yang ditimbulkannya dalam berbagai tataran kepastian. Tipe 1 mengekspresikan kemungkinan nyata masa kini atau masa depan dengan pola 'If + simple present, will + bare infinitive'. Contohnya adalah 'If temperatures continue to escalate, polar ice sheets will melt faster.'

Conditional Tipe 2 menggambarkan situasi hipotetis atau kontrafaktual pada masa sekarang, menggunakan pola 'If + past simple, would/could + bare infinitive'. Penggunaan bentuk 'were' menggantikan 'was' untuk seluruh subjek dalam ragam formal, seperti 'If the specimen were intact, researchers could extract preserved cellular material.' Kalimat ini menegaskan bahwa kondisi tersebut bertentangan dengan kenyataan saat ini.

Conditional Tipe 3 merujuk pada pengandaian masa lampau yang tidak mungkin terwujud, menggunakan pola 'If + past perfect, would have + past participle'. Kalimat 'If the vessel had received the tempest warning earlier, the captain would have steered toward a safer harbour' mencerminkan evaluasi peristiwa historis. Struktur ini digunakan untuk mengevaluasi dampak keputusan di masa lalu.

Inversi bersyarat (inverted conditionals) dapat menggantikan kata sambung 'if' dalam teks akademik formal melalui pembalikan letak subjek dan kata kerja bantu. Pola ini terlihat pada 'Had the engineers reinforced the foundation, the seismic tremor would not have collapsed the bridge.' Gaya sintaksis ini meningkatkan derajat formalitas tulisan.

Klausa subjungtif setelah kata kerja yang menuntut urgensi seperti 'demand', 'recommend', dan 'insist' wajib memakai bare infinitive tanpa imbuhan orang ketiga. Contohnya adalah 'The inspector demanded that the factory halt chemical drainage immediately.' Pola yang sama berlaku pada ekspresi 'wish' kontrafaktual seperti 'I wish the data were more comprehensive.'

quiz.q: Which sentence represents a Conditional Type 2 indicating a hypothetical present situation?
options: If the team finishes early, they will celebrate at the restaurant.
If she had arrived on time, she would have met the keynote speaker.
If the laboratory were better equipped, scholars could conduct advanced trials.
If water freezes at zero degrees, it turns into solid ice.

quiz.q: Complete the Conditional Type 3 sentence correctly: 'If the defense system ____________ the missile, the city would have escaped devastation.'
Choose the correct inverted conditional structure that replaces 'If he had known the risks'.
options: Should he had known the risks

quiz.q: Identify the grammatically correct subjunctive sentence following a verb of recommendation.
options: The committee suggested that the scholar submits his research proposal soon.
The committee suggested that the scholar submit his research proposal soon.
The committee suggested that the scholar submitted his research proposal soon.
The committee suggested that the scholar will submit his research proposal soon.

quiz.q: Which form of 'to be' is formally required across all persons in hypothetical Type 2 conditional clauses?
What does the speaker imply by saying: 'If we had preserved the mangrove forests, coastal erosion would not have occurred'?
options: The mangroves were properly preserved, so erosion was prevented.
The mangroves will be planted soon to prevent future erosion.
The mangroves were not preserved, and coastal erosion actually took place.
The mangroves are currently thriving despite ongoing coastal erosion.

chapters.title: Teks Diskusi dan Analisis Sudut Pandang
paragraphs: Discussion text menyajikan pembahasan komprehensif mengenai isu kontroversial dengan membedah minimal dua sudut pandang yang saling bertentangan secara berimbang. Teks ini tidak boleh berpihak sejak awal, melainkan memberikan ruang proporsional bagi argumen pro dan kontra. Tujuannya adalah memperluas wawasan pembaca sebelum menarik kesimpulan objektif.

Struktur teks diskusi tersusun atas issue, arguments supporting (pros), arguments opposing (cons), dan conclusion or recommendation. Bagian issue memaparkan latar belakang perdebatan publik, misalnya 'The deployment of automated surveillance in urban centers sparks contentious ethical debates.' Paragraf argumen pendukung dan penentang kemudian disusun dalam segmen terpisah.

Contrastive discourse markers memegang peranan krusial untuk menghubungkan sudut pandang yang berlawanan tanpa memicu kerancuan logika. Kata transisi seperti 'on the other hand', 'conversely', 'in contrast', dan 'nevertheless' menandai pergeseran perspektif. Contoh penggunaannya adalah 'Proponents cite reduced crime rates; on the other hand, civil liberties advocates decry privacy infringements.'

Penulis teks diskusi menerapkan reporting verbs yang bersifat netral untuk merefleksikan posisi masing-masing kubu, contohnya 'advocates argue', 'opponents contend', atau 'critics emphasize'. Gaya pelaporan ini menjaga netralitas suara penulis di dalam teks. Objektivitas bahasa membedakan teks diskusi dari teks eksposisi yang persuasif.

Bagian conclusion menyintesis kedua perspektif yang berlawanan atau merekomendasikan jalan tengah yang dapat mengakomodasi kepentingan kedua belah pihak. Penutup dapat diformulasikan menjadi 'Ultimately, the integration of automation must be balanced with robust statutory privacy safeguards.' Kesimpulan ini memberikan sintesis tanpa mereduksi kompleksitas isu yang dikaji.

quiz.q: What is the primary structural characteristic of a discussion text?
options: It presents only a single biased opinion to convert the reader's view.
It alternates between rhyming verses and narrative character dialogue.
It presents balanced opposing perspectives before providing a synthesis.
It lists chronological events of a historical figure's life journey.

quiz.q: Which transitional phrase marks a direct contrast between opposing viewpoints?
Choose the reporting verb phrase suitable for introducing an opposing perspective neutrally.
What should the conclusion paragraph of a discussion text ideally achieve?
options: Introduce a completely new controversy unrelated to the issue
Provide a balanced synthesis or a fair middle-ground resolution
Insult the proponents who provided weaker empirical data
Repeat all statistical numbers presented in the body paragraphs

quiz.q: Which sentence functions as an effective 'issue' opening for a discussion text?
options: I hate social media because it ruins personal concentration during study.
Once upon a time, people wrote handwritten letters to exchange news.
The integration of artificial intelligence in healthcare elicits both praise and concern.
You must uninstall your mobile applications immediately to protect your privacy.

quiz.q: Why must the tone of a discussion text remain neutral throughout the body paragraphs?
options: To allow the reader to examine both perspectives objectively
Because the author is legally prohibited from possessing any personal opinion
To make the essay as lengthy and complicated as grammatically possible
Because English grammar requires that every essay lack emotional adjectives

chapters.title: Teks Ulasan dan Kritik Karya
paragraphs: Review text berfungsi mengevaluasi kualitas artistik, kelebihan, serta kelemahan karya sastra, film, pertunjukan teater, buku nonfiksi, atau karya seni lainnya. Ulasan yang bermutu memberikan kritik konstruktif yang berlandaskan analisis elemen estetis, alur cerita, atau metodologi karya. Teks ini membantu audiens menentukan apakah karya tersebut bernilai untuk diapresiasi.

Struktur generik teks ulasan terdiri dari orientation, interpretative recount, evaluation, dan evaluative summation. Orientation memperkenalkan judul karya, pembuat, latar belakang genre, serta konteks perilisannya. Interpretative recount merangkum alur narasi secara selektif tanpa mengungkap spoiler klimaks karya secara berlebihan.

Bagian evaluation membedah aspek teknis karya menggunakan kosakata evaluatif bernilai rasa estetika tinggi. Penilai dapat menggunakan adjektiva seperti 'compelling', 'thought-provoking', dan 'nuanced' untuk memuji karya, atau 'predictable', 'lackluster', dan 'melodramatic' untuk mengkritik. Evaluasi mendalam menelaah akting, sinematografi, atau kekayaan bahasa.

Relative clauses (klausa relatif) memegang peranan penting untuk mendeskripsikan karakter atau plot kompleks secara terpadu. Contohnya adalah 'The protagonist, whose internal moral dilemmas anchor the entire narrative, delivers an extraordinary performance.' Penggunaan kata ganti relatif 'who', 'whom', 'whose', dan 'which' memadatkan informasi secara presisi.

Evaluative summation merangkum penilaian keseluruhan serta memberikan rekomendasi definitif mengenai sasaran pembaca atau penonton yang tepat. Bagian ini dapat berbunyi 'Despite minor pacing flaws in the second act, the film remains an essential viewing experience for sci-fi enthusiasts.' Penilaian akhir ini menegaskan bobot karya secara menyeluruh.

quiz.q: What is the primary function of an interpretative recount within a review text?
options: To provide a selective summary of the plot or thematic elements
To advertise ticket prices and cinema screening schedules
To interview the director about their personal lifestyle choices
To instruct the reader on how to write a full screenplay

quiz.q: Which adjective carries a negative evaluative connotation in a critical review?
Identify the relative pronoun used correctly to indicate possession in a descriptive clause.
Which sentence represents an evaluative summation of a published novel?
options: The novel was published in hardcover by a London firm in May 2021.
Despite its slow opening chapters, the book offers a deeply rewarding philosophical journey.
The main character travels across three European continents by railway.
The font size used across the paper pages measures exactly twelve points.

quiz.q: Which relative pronoun correctly completes the sentence: 'The director, ____________ vision transformed the project, received critical acclaim.'?
What information should typically be avoided in the interpretative recount of a film review?
options: Major plot spoilers that ruin the climax and ending for prospective viewers
The names of the primary actors portraying central fictional roles
The foundational thematic setting in which the story takes place
The genre classification to which the cinematic production belongs

chapters.title: Kalimat Langsung dan Tak Langsung dalam Pelaporan
paragraphs: Pengubahan direct speech menjadi indirect speech dalam wacana jurnalistik dan akademis menuntut kepatuhan terhadap prinsip backshift tenses. Apabila reporting verb berbentuk lampau seperti 'stated' atau 'revealed', kata kerja dalam klausa laporan mundur satu tingkat ke masa lampau. Simple present berubah menjadi simple past, sedangkan present perfect bergeser menjadi past perfect.

Pergeseran deiksis waktu dan tempat harus diselaraskan secara akurat dengan konteks pelaporan. Kata keterangan 'now' bermutasi menjadi 'then', 'today' menjadi 'that day', dan 'tomorrow' berganti menjadi 'the following day' atau 'the next day'. Begitu pula kata tunjuk 'this' dan 'these' yang secara sistematis berubah menjadi 'that' dan 'those'.

Dalam pelaporan kalimat tanya (reported questions), susunan kata kembali ke pola deklaratif (subjek mendahului predikat) tanpa auxiliary verbs pembalik seperti 'do', 'does', atau 'did'. Untuk yes/no questions, klausa pelapor menggunakan konjungsi 'if' atau 'whether', contohnya 'The auditor inquired whether the accounting department had finalized the balance sheet.'

Perintah dan permohonan langsung ditransformasikan menjadi indirect speech menggunakan konstruksi infinitive dengan 'to' atau 'not to'. Bentuk 'Submit your paperwork before five' diubah menjadi 'The manager instructed the clerks to submit their paperwork before five.' Pola ini menghasilkan kalimat formal yang ringkas dan lugas.

Variasi reporting verbs memperkaya akurasi konteks tutur melampaui kata kerja dasar 'said' dan 'told'. Verba seperti 'acknowledged', 'disputed', 'advocated', dan 'reiterated' memberikan indikasi sikap pembicara yang spesifik. Contoh penggunaannya adalah 'The spokesperson acknowledged that supply chains had experienced unexpected bottlenecks.'

quiz.q: How does the direct quote 'I have inspected the facility' change into reported speech introduced by 'He said'?
options: He said that he has inspected the facility.
He said that he had inspected the facility.
He said that he will inspect the facility.
He said that he inspects the facility.

quiz.q: Which indirect question maintains the correct grammatical word order?
options: She asked where was the technical documentation stored.
She asked where the technical documentation was stored.
She asked where did they store the technical documentation.
She asked where had they store the technical documentation.

quiz.q: What does the time adverbial 'tomorrow' become when shifted into formal reported speech?
How should the direct order 'Do not disclose the password' be reported formally?
options: The officer warned us not to disclose the password.
The officer warned us that we do not disclose the password.
The officer warned us to not disclosing the password.
The officer warned us didn't disclose the password.

quiz.q: Which connector is required when reporting a direct Yes/No question?
Select the reporting verb that explicitly implies a formal admission of a past fault.

chapters.title: Korespondensi Resmi dan Penulisan Riwayat Hidup
paragraphs: Korespondensi bisnis resmi dan penulisan surat lamaran kerja (job application letter) menuntut kepatuhan mutlak terhadap konvensi tata letak dan register formal. Surat harus memuat heading, recipient information, salutation formal, body paragraphs, dan complimentary close yang baku. Integritas profesional tercermin dari akurasi ejaan dan konsistensi nada bahasa.

Salutation dan complimentary close memiliki relasi yang terikat oleh aturan etiket surat-menyurat internasional. Jika nama penerima surat diketahui sejak awal, salam pembuka yang digunakan adalah 'Dear Mr. Davies' yang dipasangkan dengan penutup 'Yours sincerely'. Sebaliknya, bila identitas penerima tidak spesifik ('Dear Sir or Madam'), penutup wajib menggunakan 'Yours faithfully'.

Body paragraph pertama dalam application letter harus merujuk posisi yang dilamar serta sumber informasi lowongan secara langsung. Contoh formulasi kalimatnya adalah 'I am writing to express my interest in the Data Analyst position advertised on your corporate portal.' Pendekatan langsung ini menghormati efisiensi waktu perekrut.

Penyusunan Curriculum Vitae (CV) mengandalkan action verbs berorientasi hasil pada awal setiap butir pencapaian kerja. Pelamar sebaiknya menggunakan verba operasional seperti 'orchestrated', 'streamlined', 'pioneered', atau 'spearheaded' ketimbang frasa pasif 'responsible for'. Penggunaan metrik terukur seperti 'increased efficiency by twenty percent' semakin memperkuat daya saing profil.

Bagian penutup surat lamaran memuat call to action yang sopan untuk mengantisipasi tindak lanjut wawancara. Penulis dapat menyatakan 'I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications in an interview and have attached my resume for your review.' Struktur komunikasi profesional ini menutup interaksi tertulis secara elegan.

quiz.q: Which complimentary close correctly pairs with the formal salutation 'Dear Sir or Madam'?
Which sentence serves as an effective, professional opening for a job application letter?
options: Hello there, I saw your job post and decided to send my papers right away.
I am writing to express my interest in the Junior Software Engineer position advertised on your website.
Do you still have an open position for someone who wants to work in your company?
I really need a job this month, so I hope you will hire me as an engineer.

quiz.q: Which dynamic action verb is most effective for demonstrating leadership on a CV?
What is the recommended complimentary close when addressing a known recipient like 'Dear Ms. Jenkins'?
How should achievements on a modern professional resume ideally be presented?
options: As long philosophical narratives describing personal dreams
As concise bullet points initiated by strong action verbs and quantifiable results
As informal notes handwritten in colorful cursive script
As a list of social media usernames without any descriptions of past responsibilities

quiz.q: Choose the most appropriate phrase to express anticipation of a job interview politely.
options: Call me tomorrow morning or I will look for another corporate position.
I demand an immediate interview session to prove my superior expertise.
I welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications in a personal interview.
You should definitely interview me because my credentials are unmatched.

chapters.title: Greeting and Introducing Myself
paragraphs: Greeting is the first step to start a conversation with new friends. You can say Hello or Hi to greet someone politely.
When you meet someone in the morning, you say Good morning. In the afternoon, you say Good afternoon to greet your friends.
To introduce yourself, you use the sentence My name is followed by your name. You can also say I am to tell people who you are.
Asking for someone's name is done by saying What is your name. The person will answer with My name is and their name.
Saying goodbye is important when you leave. You can say Goodbye or See you later to your friends.

quiz.q: What do you say to greet a friend in the morning?
How do you introduce yourself?
What is the correct response to What is your name?
Which phrase is used to end a conversation?
You meet a friend at 2 PM, what do you say?
What do you say if you want to know someone's name?
